candidate: full-flow default nonblocking CUDA in PR 57
numeric_gate: Identical complete token output, count, finish reason for every paired request.
statistics: Each process pair is an independent unit; compute per-case medians per process, paired candidate/baseline ratios, median ratio and exact empirical cluster bootstrap 95% CI over the five pairs. Never treat individual tokens as independent samples.
regression_gate: Report every case separately. Latency ratios must have 95% CI upper bound <=1.10; investigate all observed regressions. No aggregate speedup may mask a slower case. No claim of p99 SLO from this finite matrix.
minimum_useful_gain: At least 5% lower latency or higher throughput in an affected case, with 95% interval excluding no change; otherwise report that async ownership alone has not shown a meaningful service speedup.
stopping: Start with five independent pairs. Preserve failures. If threshold is inconclusive, collect up to five additional pairs with alternating order; do not exclude unfavorable samples.
constraints: Same RTX 5090 UUID, models, input hashes, sampling, cache, resource limits and release flags; no parallel builds or other benchmarks during trials. Record background GPU processes, startup and memory peaks separately.

tuning.environment: Existing INFER_CUDA_TUNING_TABLE selects the identical frozen table; it does not enable asynchronous execution.

tail_statistics: Report nearest-rank observed p95 across measured requests per case with sample count, without treating it as a production SLO or inferring p99.
preliminary_runs: Earlier bab3482/b793428 pilot, diagnostic and final-p0 reports are retained outside this revised candidate. A 27B MTP0 preflight was rejected before measurement because the runner passed 32768 rather than the checklist 65536; the runner now reads this limit from each frozen profile.
build_command: cargo build --locked --release -p infer-cli --no-default-features --features cuda (default features are empty on both sides); workspace release profile, rustc 1.99.0. Parallel build-job count does not override codegen-units.

supplemental_private_decode.reason: Original27B hot_long completes at EOS without enough visible tokens for TPOT; preserve that result and additionally measure private decode using the registered short question after newline padding. Other cases remain unchanged.
supplemental_private_decode.requirements: Both sides must produce identical complete trajectories and the hot case must expose TPOT; unavailable results are never interpreted as zero latency.
supplemental_private_decode.scope: Only hot_long, with a fresh process and one cache-filling warmup. Original four-case profiles cover short/long/batch4; do not repeat those unchanged cases in this additive coverage experiment. Registered before the first supplemental run.
